Django 6: security headers, nonce CSP, cache rules
recipes.snippet:
Django 6.0+ (current 6.1): built-in CSP middleware with a fresh per-response nonce, SecurityMiddleware for the rest. For Django 5.2 use django-csp (equivalent at the end). Give every <script> in templates nonce="{{ csp_nonce }}". Needs: pip install whitenoise.
### file: config/settings.py
import os

from django.utils.csp import CSP  # Django 6.0+

PRODUCTION = os.environ.get("DEPLOY_ENV") == "production"  # the only production switch (IDX-005)
SITE_URL = os.environ.get("SITE_URL", "https://example.com")

MIDDLEWARE = [
    "django.middleware.security.SecurityMiddleware",
    "whitenoise.middleware.WhiteNoiseMiddleware",  # directly after SecurityMiddleware
    "core.middleware.security_headers",  # above CsrfViewMiddleware so it sees the csrftoken Set-Cookie
    "django.contrib.sessions.middleware.SessionMiddleware",
    "django.middleware.common.CommonMiddleware",
    "django.middleware.csrf.CsrfViewMiddleware",
    "django.contrib.auth.middleware.AuthenticationMiddleware",
    "django.middleware.clickjacking.XFrameOptionsMiddleware",  # X-Frame-Options: DENY (default)
    "django.middleware.csp.ContentSecurityPolicyMiddleware",  # near the bottom, after anything using csp_nonce
]
# Makes {{ csp_nonce }} available in templates (the nonce is only generated when a template reads it).
TEMPLATES[0]["OPTIONS"]["context_processors"].append("django.template.context_processors.csp")

# SEC-010 / SEC-075: nonce + strict-dynamic, no unsafe-inline, no wildcard, frame-ancestors, object-src, base-uri.
# Resulting header: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-...' 'strict-dynamic'; style-src 'self' 'nonce-...';
#   img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self';
#   form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
SECURE_CSP = {
    "default-src": [CSP.SELF],
    "script-src": [CSP.SELF, CSP.NONCE, CSP.STRICT_DYNAMIC],
    "style-src": [CSP.SELF, CSP.NONCE],
    "img-src": [CSP.SELF, "data:"],
    "font-src": [CSP.SELF],
    "connect-src": [CSP.SELF],
    "object-src": [CSP.NONE],
    "base-uri": [CSP.SELF],
    "form-action": [CSP.SELF],
    "frame-ancestors": [CSP.NONE],
    "upgrade-insecure-requests": True,  # True renders a valueless directive
}

SECURE_CONTENT_TYPE_NOSNIFF = True  # X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
SECURE_REFERRER_POLICY = "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"  # Referrer-Policy header
X_FRAME_OPTIONS = "DENY"
SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS = 63072000  # sent on HTTPS requests only
SECURE_HSTS_INCLUDE_SUBDOMAINS = True
SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT = PRODUCTION
SECURE_REDIRECT_EXEMPT = [r"^api/health$"]  # plain-HTTP load-balancer probe (regex on the path without leading "/")
SECURE_PROXY_SSL_HEADER = ("HTTP_X_FORWARDED_PROTO", "https")  # only if the proxy overwrites this header
CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE = SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = PRODUCTION
CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS = [SITE_URL]

# PRF-008: WhiteNoise sends "Cache-Control: max-age=315360000, public, immutable" (10 years, above the 31536000
# floor) for files named by the manifest (app.<hash>.css); run "python manage.py collectstatic" at build time.
STATIC_URL = "static/"
STATIC_ROOT = BASE_DIR / "staticfiles"
STORAGES = {
    "default": {"BACKEND": "django.core.files.storage.FileSystemStorage"},
    "staticfiles": {"BACKEND": "whitenoise.storage.CompressedManifestStaticFilesStorage"},
}

# Django 5.2 (no built-in CSP): pip install "django-csp>=4"; use "csp.middleware.CSPMiddleware" instead of the
# CSP middleware above; add the context processor "csp.context_processors.nonce" (template variable {{ CSP_NONCE }}):
#   from csp.constants import NONCE, NONE, SELF, STRICT_DYNAMIC
#   CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY = {"DIRECTIVES": {"default-src": [SELF], "script-src": [SELF, NONCE, STRICT_DYNAMIC],
#       "style-src": [SELF, NONCE], "object-src": [NONE], "base-uri": [SELF], "form-action": [SELF],
#       "frame-ancestors": [NONE], "upgrade-insecure-requests": True}}
### file: core/middleware.py
from django.utils.cache import patch_cache_control

# No built-in setting for Permissions-Policy: a valid RFC 8941 dictionary.
PERMISSIONS_POLICY = "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()"


def security_headers(get_response):
    def middleware(request):
        response = get_response(request)
        response.headers.setdefault("Permissions-Policy", PERMISSIONS_POLICY)
        is_html = response.headers.get("Content-Type", "").startswith("text/html")
        if is_html and "Cache-Control" not in response.headers:
            if response.cookies:  # e.g. csrftoken: never shared-cacheable (SEC-016)
                patch_cache_control(response, private=True, max_age=0, must_revalidate=True)
            else:  # PRF-008: HTML revalidates every time
                patch_cache_control(response, public=True, max_age=0, must_revalidate=True)
        return response

    return middleware

recipes.title: Django: /api/health with a database check
recipes.snippet:
Django 6.x. One route, /api/health: 200 {"status":"ok"} when the process and the database answer, 503 {"status":"unavailable"} otherwise. never_cache sets Cache-Control with no-store. The body never contains versions, hostnames or the exception. If the project has no database, replace the SELECT 1 block with a check of its critical dependency (keep the pattern: failure -> 503).
### file: core/health.py
import logging

from django.db import connection
from django.http import JsonResponse
from django.views.decorators.cache import never_cache
from django.views.decorators.http import require_safe

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@require_safe
@never_cache
def health(request):
    try:
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:  # ~2 s limit comes from OPTIONS connect_timeout below
            cursor.execute("SELECT 1")
            cursor.fetchone()
    except Exception:  # any failure means "not ready"; details stay in the server log, never in the body
        log.warning("health check: database unavailable", exc_info=True)
        return JsonResponse({"status": "unavailable"}, status=503)
    return JsonResponse({"status": "ok"})
### file: config/urls.py
from django.urls import path

from core.health import health

urlpatterns = [
    path("api/health", health, name="health"),  # add next to your other routes
]
### file: config/settings.py
# Keep the probe fast when the database is down (libpq option for the postgresql backend).
DATABASES["default"].setdefault("OPTIONS", {})["connect_timeout"] = 2
